\[
a^2+b^2+c^2+4-ab-3b-2c
= (a-\tfrac b2)^2+\left((b-\tfrac32)^2-\tfrac{b^2}{4}\right)+(c-1)^2+\tfrac34
\]
Since
\[
(b-\tfrac32)^2-\tfrac{b^2}{4}=\tfrac34(b-2)^2-\tfrac34,
\]
we get
\[
(a-\tfrac b2)^2+\tfrac34(b-2)^2+(c-1)^2\le 0.
\]
Thus all squares are zero:
\[
a=\frac b2,\quad b=2,\quad c=1.
\]
So \(a=1\), and
\[
200a+9b+c=200+18+1=219.
\]

\[
\boxed{219}
\]
